authority_note: Values below are the observed behavior of the frozen Pine release. The Python replica must match them. Any deliberate rule improvement requires contract_version+1, a new Pine version id, and a new report.

phase.note: bullPhase = rising OR >= bull_floor; bearPhase = falling OR <= bear_ceiling. Both are near-vacuous by construction; recorded as frozen behavior.

levels.obstacle_eligibility: candidate must be beyond reference by more than touch tolerance (f_pick_above/f_pick_below)
levels.saty_anchor: previous daily close via request.security('D', close[1], lookahead_on)
levels.saty_atr: previous daily ta.atr(14) via the same request

routes.trend_ignition: route condition is (trend_route OR close beyond 3m anchor cloud); a proven ignition always satisfies the second clause, so ignition is effectively never route-blocked. Recorded as frozen behavior and a known design risk.

arbitration.long_vs_short_same_bar: higher setup priority wins; tie -> higher grade wins; tie -> bullish candle (close >= open) chooses long
arbitration.dedup: per-setup edge: ready AND NOT ready[1]; no global cooldown, no daily quota

plan.t2_action: exit 25%; runner kept only if confirmed 10m trend AND 3m pace align with plan side, effective stop -> T1; otherwise plan ends
plan.reverse: non-countertrend opposite signal ends the plan (REVERSE) and opens the new plan on the same bar
plan.countertrend_vs_open_plan: signal is recorded with role COUNTERTREND_ADVISORY; the frozen plan is not modified
plan.add: same-side signal while plan active is recorded with role ADD; plan and broker position unchanged
plan.same_bar_stop_and_reentry: allowed: lifecycle runs before new-signal creation on the same confirmed close

series_semantics.ta_ema_seeding: na for the first length-1 defined inputs; seeded with the SMA of the first length inputs; recursive afterwards (established empirically 2026-07-21)
series_semantics.ta_atr_seeding: RMA: na until length TRs, seeded with their SMA, Wilder update afterwards; first TR = high-low
series_semantics.ta_stdev: population (biased) standard deviation over the window; na until the window fills
series_semantics.pivot_tie_rule: ta.pivotlow/pivothigh allow ties on the LEFT side and require strict improvement on the RIGHT side, so the most recent bar of a flat double top/bottom becomes the pivot (established empirically 2026-07-21)
series_semantics.daily_bar_close: session-chained: a daily bar closes at min(open+24h, next bar's open); the CAPITALCOM Sunday-reopen bar is 23h
series_semantics.float_boundary_floor: comparisons decided by margins <= ~2e-12 at price levels are not reproducible from outside the Pine runtime; Pine's own 3m and 10m hosts can disagree on such bars (see IDM_V11_PARITY_2026-07-21.md section 4)

context.boundary_semantics: request.security(tf, expr[1], lookahead_on): a 3m bar maps to the HTF bar containing its OPEN time and reads the bar before that (empirically established against the 2026-07-21 true export; equivalently: last HTF close <= 3m open). A 3m bar straddling an HTF boundary still reads the HTF bar that closed before the straddled boundary.
context.warmup: no readiness gate: na values propagate false, so setups start firing as soon as ATR(14) and the touched level sources become defined

identity.signal_id: close_time_ms + (100 if long else 200) + setup_code*10 + grade_code
